mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies today with a temperature of 65 degrees at Verona City Hall, and a first quarter moon is visible.

City officials are moving forward with the Mark Drive reconstruction project. Phase two is underway, which includes underground utility work between Nine Mound Road and Todd Street. Residents should expect occasional lane closures and flaggers in the area.

There is plenty to do in our community today, including live music at Paddy Mac's, the UGM event at Epic Systems, yoga at Insight Wellness, the Downtown Farmers Market at Hometown Junction Park, pizza at Lake Lou-ee, and trivia at The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead to tomorrow, you can catch the free Concerts in the Park series at Century School Park or join the fun at Hop Haus trivia night.

In terms of public safety, the police department reported that on Friday, officers arrested a driver for an O W I after they were found unresponsive in their vehicle near North Main Street and Cross Country Road.

Culver's is currently closed, but they will open their doors at 10 AM to serve the delicious Double Strawberry flavor of the day. If you are looking for other treats today, keep an eye out for any local Kona Ice stops in the area.
